answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique Verkle-tree state commitment, so a new agent onboards only through a stateless proof of a distinct leaf, isolating each participant as island in the commitment scheme. Colluding agents that reuse a subtree root are pruned from the garden of valid leaves, and any whisper of duplicated witness data triggers. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
